verdict.rationale: An AI platform with an Agents API could plausibly offer event-triggered automation rules, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no such feature. Function calling and agent handoffs are developer building blocks invoked within a request. Custom guardrails are moderation rules declared per request, not event-triggered actions. There is no documented trigger, event subscription or rule engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
